user.title: Connect to PiGPIO Daemon
user.description: Enter the hostname and port of the Raspberry Pi running the pigpio daemon.

mac.title: MAC Address
mac.description: Could not automatically discover the MAC address. Enter the MAC address of the Raspberry Pi (e.g. from `ip link` or the device label).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to pigpio daemon. Ensure pigpiod is running on the target host.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid MAC address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.already_configured: This PiGPIO host is already configured.

daemon_unreachable.title: PiGPIO daemon unreachable
daemon_unreachable.description: Cannot connect to the pigpio daemon at {host}:{port}. Ensure pigpiod is running and reachable from Home Assistant.

abort.no_pins: No GPIO pins configured to remove.

error.gpio_in_use: This GPIO number is already configured.
